I have completed the independent scientific viability review of Hypothesis 3 (`h3_v2`) against [REVIEW_CONTRACT.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/REVIEW_CONTRACT.md) and written the required outputs to [review.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h3_review1/review.txt) and [verdicts.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h3_review1/verdicts.json).

### Summary of Findings (`h3_v2`)

- **What `h3_v2` Established:**
  1. **Empirical Proof of Top-1 Subsampling Bias:** [03_pilot_subsample_search.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/03_pilot_subsample_search.py) (Job `53700569`, [pilot_top1_bias_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/results/pilot_top1_bias_summary.tsv)) proves that post-hoc filtering of `-k 1` hit tables misses 87.30% (`110/126`) of true empirical dark hits and 93.91% (`895/953`) of true empirical control hits on a 2,500-genome GEM subset.
  2. **Public Source Retrieval and Narrowed Framing:** [04_fetch_smag_parts.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/04_fetch_smag_parts.py) retrieves `mag.tar.gz.aa` and `mag.tar.gz.ab` from Zenodo Record 8223844 with verified MD5 checksums ([zenodo_8223844.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/public_source_checks/zenodo_8223844.json)), avoiding local permission barriers, while [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DESIGN.md#L21-L27) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DOSSIER.md#L25-L30) drop control-based calibration claims.

- **Critical Issues Requiring Revision (`REVISE`):**
  1. **Reference Subsets Are Raw-Count Overshoot Sampled, Not Length-Matched or Deduplicated:** Despite [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DOSSIER.md#L1) and [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DESIGN.md#L24) claiming length-matched reference comparison, [06_match_gem_and_search.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/06_match_gem_and_search.py#L68-L98) concatenates whole GEM proteomes until `g_prot >= s_prot` (`694,598` vs `693,227`). In [smag_vs_gem_redundancy_overlap_audit.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/results/smag_vs_gem_redundancy_overlap_audit.tsv#L2-L8) and the IBEX reference FASTAs, GEM has +9.28% more characters, higher mean/median length (`319.20`/`271.00` aa vs `292.68`/`252.00` aa), 15.1× higher duplicate rate (`2.26%` vs `0.15%`, leaving `678,867` canonical unique GEM sequences vs `692,194` in SMAG), and major length-stratum imbalances (+16.8% more `<100` aa and +12.3% more `100–149` aa targets in SMAG; +17.5% more `>=400` aa targets in GEM).
  2. **Uncanonicalized Trailing Stop Codons (`*`) Corrupt Length and Overlap Audits:** [05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py#L31) runs Pyrodigal with `--no-stop-codon` (`0/693,227` trailing `*`), whereas [06_match_gem_and_search.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/06_match_gem_and_search.py#L81-L90) retains trailing `*` on `663,757/694,598` (`95.56%`) of published GEM proteins without stripping `*` in `read_fasta_stats` or `hash_fasta`. This inflates GEM residue counts by `+663,757`, shifts complete GEM lengths by `+1` aa, and forces exact MD5 overlap for complete proteins to `0` (`0.00%` reported vs **30 exact shared sequences** after `rstrip("*").upper()`).
  3. **Unsafe Partial Tar Extraction, Non-Deterministic FASTA Order, and Deleted Unhashed Genomes:** Contradicting [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DESIGN.md#L59-L61), [05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py#L84-L120) does not use `tarfile` or check `member.size`; it runs `tar -xz ... 2>/dev/null || true`, checks only leading `>` and trailing `\n`, writes `smag_pilot_recalled.faa` in non-deterministic `as_completed` thread order ([L140-L145](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py#L140-L145)), and deletes all 212 extracted nucleotide FASTAs without SHA-256 hashes ([L169-L171](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/05_extract_and_genecall_smag.py#L169-L171)).
  4. **Missing GEM Manifest/Hashes, Hit-Rule Mismatch, Query-Weighting Distortion, and Overstated §8 Claims:** [06_match_gem_and_search.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/scripts/06_match_gem_and_search.py#L76-L95) never records the 292 sampled GEM filenames; [INPUTS.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/INPUTS.tsv#L22-L23) marks both searched pilot FASTAs as `uncomputed_large`; [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DOSSIER.md#L39) specifies $\ge 30\%$ identity while code applies only `E <= 1e-3` (`28/1,089` SMAG and `21/926` GEM hits have `pident < 30%`); equal-quota query bins are summed unweighted and pooled across `dark + ctrl`; and [DOSSIER.md §8](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h3_v2/DOSSIER.md#L203-L210) reintroduces causal biome and caller-independent claims.

**Verdict:** `REVISE`
